name: com.ironsource.adapters.custom.yandex.IronsourceIntegrityCheckProvider
description: The Yandex Mobile Ads IronSource mediation adapter starts this provider with the app. In debuggable builds it logs that this adapter version is unsupported and reports its integration status.
disableEffect: Only the adapter warning and startup messages in debuggable builds are lost; this provider does not change normal app features.
